title: Playboy Magazine September 1987 Women of 007 James Bond Timothy Dalton Maryam
conditionDescription: Cover clean with light edge wear. Centerfold not separately verified - please ask before buying if that matters to you.
descriptionText:
Vintage Playboy Magazine, September 1987 issue. Cover price $3.50.

Features:
- The Women of 007 - celebrating three decades of James Bond in Playboy, with Timothy Dalton's The Living Daylights
- Plus 007's dangerous new sensation, Maryam d'Abo
- Spy Wars: Has the K.G.B. Cracked the CIA?
- Who Are the N.F.L.'s Best? Pro Football Preview
- The 1987 Sexy Scandal Test

Bond collage cover with the Aston Martin. The back cover carries a 1987 Marlboro Man ad.

Condition: pre-owned with normal signs of age and storage. Cover clean with light edge wear. The centerfold has not been separately verified - please ask before buying if that matters to you. Please review the photos - they are of the actual copy you will receive.
